evaluator.notes: Manual evidence-led evaluation; no evaluator rerun.

session_selection.rationale: Single benchmark root and persisted subagent tree.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source builds in network-disabled scratch with configured externals, 2 CPUs/4 GiB/128 processes and 240-second timeout.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses required inputs and restart. output.cpp:97 writes only a state array; transient driver initializes both histories from that state and restarts its clock, so it cannot faithfully resume a BDF2 transient.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Modules separate case, mesh, partition, flux, finite-volume solver and output. The implementation remains fixed 2-D.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted source with MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct existing CFD solver executable call found. External source similarity/licensing not exhaustively audited.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case inputs select mesh/physics; Re200 source adds a disclosed 4-degree inflow perturbation for t=2–12. Arbitrary meshes were not independently run.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:127–151 reads mesh per rank during preprocessing then releases global mesh on nonroot before solve; partition.cpp and fvsolver.cpp exchange neighbor U/gradients/limiters. Root retains one copy for output.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: fvsolver_run.cpp:382–399 marks residual-stall convergence without force check; M0.8 lift remains strongly variable. Restart lacks physical-time/history preservation.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Immutable source builds and original eight packages/report validate structurally; report has rank studies, but no independent case rerun or full grid-convergence proof.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modules and report generator present. Report table labels final-window means as final steady values; curated tip lacks generated figure assets needed to rebuild accepted PDF.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Compressible perfect-gas finite-volume equations and nondimensional references are implemented; selected weak-plateau force data limit demonstrated accuracy.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:103–130 supports TRI_3/QUAD_4 and boundary edges, but rejects CGNS MIXED section type; general zone/mesh cases not independently exercised.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: fvsolver.cpp:268–310 reconstructs states and adds signed face fluxes, including viscous correction. Neighbor gradient and limiter exchange are present.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.hpp contains Roe with entropy fix and Rusanov; case_config.cpp:80–82 selects Rusanov when configured. Report describes production dissipation and no shock rerun was performed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield/slip/no-slip and wall viscous paths exist; no independent full boundary validation.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: fvsolver.cpp uses least-squares reconstruction and positivity fallback; no independent full residual/grid-order study was performed.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat limiter and phi halo exchange appear in fvsolver.cpp:171–234. Plateau behavior and force variability constrain demonstrated solution quality.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: fvsolver.cpp uses corrected gradients; fvsolver_run.cpp:40–70 projects tangential wall traction for friction split. Full normal viscous contribution is omitted from total; no independent wall-grid convergence.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Implicit sweeps and local CFL exist, but source accepts residual-stall plateau without force criterion; M0.8 inviscid violates required stable-force condition.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Fresh BDF2 history and strict target ratio checks exist (fvsolver_run.cpp:474–514), with documented 4-degree inflow perturbation t=2–12 and underpredicted shedding. Restart discards prior history/time.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS, neighbor state/gradient/limiter halos and reductions are implemented. Nonroot global meshes are released before solve, root retains one for output.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Structural validation passes original packages, but M0.8 inviscid metadata marks a force-unstable residual plateau converged; transient restart does not preserve history/time.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original eight packages and report pass structural validator; this does not establish stable force plateaus or physical accuracy.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 reaches t=300 with actual target checks; M0.8 inviscid is incorrectly marked converged despite a moving lift tail and only 2.08/4 residual orders.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd≈2.019 is plausible; M0.8 inviscid lift varies strongly, M2 inviscid achieves 0.60 residual orders, M2 laminar Cd tail changes ~20%, and Re200 underpredicts St/amplitude.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted PDF shows all case histories/fields, including readable Re200 late lift/drag and wake. Curated source lacks some figure assets for complete reproduction.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses weak residual reductions and Re200 perturbation, but labels moving M0.8 lift steady and table calls final-window means final steady values.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: PDF SHA and immutable TeX provenance verified; tools/analyze.py computes final-window means. Table caption mislabels them as final rows; full pixel-to-field audit not performed.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean build 4/4, CLI 1.5/2 (transient restart loses time/history), output schema 1.5/2 (false steady convergence), error handling 2/2 for source-checked paths; malformed input coverage limited.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS/tags 3.5/4, geometry 2/2, mixed/multizone 1/2 (MIXED sections rejected), adjacency 2/2; arbitrary layouts untested.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual 4.5/5, Riemann flux 4/4, farfield/slip 2.5/3, no-slip 3/3; paths exist but full boundary validation not independently performed.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 3.5/4, limiter 3/3, positivity 2/2, smooth-order evidence 0.5/1. WLS/Venkat and halo paths exist; independent full residual order not established.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradients 3/3, stress/heat 3/3, no-slip wall 2/2, tangential split 1.5/2; wall traction projected tangentially, normal viscous force omitted from total and grid convergence unverified.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit 2.5/4 (plateau accepts residual stall without stable-force check), linear solve 4/4, BDF2 3.5/4 (restart loses prior time/history; fresh run tested by original evidence), inner control 3/3 (actual ratios counted).

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/owned ghosts 2/2, neighbor state/gradient/limiter exchange 3/3, reductions 2/2, rank output 1/1, np8 comparison 2/2. Nonroot global meshes released before solver, root retains one for output.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid 0.75/2 (M0.8 moving lift falsely called converged and M2 only 0.6 orders), laminar 1.25/2 (M2 last-10% Cd changes ~20%), Re20 2/2, Re200 1/2 (underprediction and perturbation), fields 1/1 and rank comparison 0.5/1.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Methods 1/1, histories 1/1, field visuals 1/1, analysis 0.25/1 (unstable M0.8 plateau called steady), traceability 0.25/1 (mean table mislabeled final, missing curated assets). Accepted PDF itself has readable plots.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics 1.5/2, BC 0.75/1, mesh abstraction 0.75/1, organization 1/1: modular but fixed 2-D implementation.

PDF pp27–30 show residual history, wake contours and force history; high-resolution inspection of p28 shows both late lift and small resolved drag oscillations with startup clipped, correcting old missing-late-plot claim. Original t≥150 forces.csv mean Cd=1.123268, Cl range −0.240739–0.244489; 24 upward mean-lift crossings give 23 periods averaging 6.20753, frequency≈0.1611. Report.tex:151–153 and solver/src/fvsolver_run.cpp:485–491 disclose a 4-degree farfield perturbation only for t=2–12; reported zero target misses are recorded by actual ratio test (:495–511). Score 2→3: floor met, but shedding amplitude, frequency and drag underpredict cited references and no independent grid convergence is shown. Missing curated figure assets remain a report-reproducibility issue. No Re200 rerun.

flags.evidence: Immutable d25cd3c fvsolver_run.cpp:382–399 declares converged on residual-stall criteria without testing force stability. Original NACA M0.8 inviscid run_status/metadata says converged at 2.08396 residual orders versus requested 4.0; last 500 forces.csv lift rows span −0.0117325 to +0.0790092, with first-half mean +0.0289760 and second-half mean −0.0077608. Report.tex:232 calls the mean forces steady, but TASK.md:172 requires stable forces for a justified plateau. This supports a false-success finding for this specific steady case; Re200 inner-target statistics are measured and are not conflated with this issue.

limitations: Immutable-source clean build passed in network-disabled scratch with configured externals, 2 CPUs/4 GiB/128 processes and 240-second timeout; no CFD case was rerun.
Accepted sibling PDF and indexed SHA match; curated tip lacks some figure assets. No exhaustive pixel-to-field or external authorship audit.
M0.8 inviscid force-unstable plateau supports DQ7; Re200 target ratios are independently counted and its documented 4-degree transient perturbation occurs only t=2–12.
Transient restart stores current state but not previous BDF level or time; independent case scores do not alter rubric or review areas.
